summary.en: Ethiopian federal forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport, while Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate the fighting, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to resolve Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopias føderale styrker har installert en midlertidig administrasjon i Tigray, og en pro-regjeringsmilits sier den har tatt kontroll over den regionale flyplassen, mens eritreiske styrker led tap der. USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å dempe kampene, og Mekelle borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Et droneangrep i det omstridte Abyei-området drepte minst 73 personer. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
